# Bobs Drawn Axes

---

## Unique Art Style
Ever wanted your axes to look like they were drawn by someone who has never seen a axe before? Now they can!

Tired of those realistic texture packs? Then welcome to **Bobs Drawn Axes**, the only pack where the bad looks are the best part! This pack replaces every single axe texture, drawn by **me**.
